opening.argument: The video presents an ordinary walkthrough of an app-rewards website. Viewers are shown app offers and a get-started flow, including a “Movie Pong” installation, while the speaker explains that continued downloads can generate credits: “keep gaining credits.” Those credits are presented as redeemable for iTunes gift cards and other rewards, with the available pages also displaying gift cards and subscription rewards. The video further shows a 320-credit balance and sharing-for-credits prompts. These features establish a conventional rewards and promotional process, not deceptive conduct or a completed loss. The separate $10 iTunes giveaway and requests to share or post for credits are participation promotions whose fulfillment and selection terms are not established.
